instruction: How to set up BIND with DNSSEC key rollovers automatically
output: echo 'dnssec-policy "rollover" { keys { ksk key-directory lifetime unlimited algorithm rsasha256 size 2048; zsk key-directory lifetime 30d algorithm rsasha256 size 1024; }; };' >> /etc/bind/named.conf

instruction: How to configure BIND for authoritative DNS with views
output: echo 'view "external" { match-clients { any; }; recursion no; zone "example.com" { type master; file "/etc/bind/db.example.com.external"; }; };' >> /etc/bind/named.conf
